prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Packaging (corrugated), Company Size: 140 employees, Pain Points: Print quality defects 4% of orders, die-cutting waste above target, no customer feedback loop, machine guards removed for maintenance and not replaced, ink VOC monitoring absent

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore": "Low", "gaps": "Current system exhibits several critical gaps: recurring print quality defects (4% of orders) indicating process control issues, die-cutting waste above target reflecting inefficiency, absence of a formal customer feedback loop hindering continuous improvement, machine guards removed during maintenance and not replaced violating safety protocols, and lack of ink VOC monitoring failing environmental compliance requirements.", "recommendations": "Implement robust process control measures including statistical process control (SPC) for print quality, conduct root cause analysis and corrective actions for die-cutting waste reduction, establish a formal customer feedback mechanism (e.g., post-delivery surveys and complaint tracking), enforce strict lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) procedures and mandatory guard replacement after maintenance, and install real-time VOC monitoring systems with automated alerts and recording for regulatory compliance.", "standards": "Primary applicable standards: ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety). Additional relevant standards include ISO 12100 (Safety of Machinery) and ISO 14229 (Pain Assessment)." }
